Format notes

        
Currently accepts Sponge .schem files up to 8 MB and 100,000 blocks. The original schematic offset is ignored; the chosen origin is the lower corner. Chest contents, signs, entities, and other block-entity data are not copied. Survival placement may use Minecraft’s normal orientation rules for stairs, doors, and similar blocks.
